corrections.text: The headline states as fact that this is "the First AWS Service Feature to Follow the DuckLabs Deal." Neither AWS source makes that claim; it comes from InfoQ, which wrote that "Amazon Aurora PostgreSQL is the first service to receive a user-facing feature powered by DuckDB" following the acquisition. The body attributes it to InfoQ.

The article does not state when AWS announced the Aurora feature. The AWS News Blog post is dated 30 September 2026, and InfoQ's report is dated 17 October 2026; the feature was not announced on the day this article was published.
